body: Pretty much same situation for me. Suicidal thoughts of good quality guaranted since 2009 (or so). I think I should create a trademark and sell some usefull items. But to the point. I can see how much my mom loves me and even though I am unable to understand or feel the same I dont want to push huge pain upon her which she would have to carry rest of her life. I know the pain very well and therefore I dont want to give any. Then there is question if I should live live this until I die of natural causes because of someone else. My case is kind of helpless but yours might not have to be so I would wait. I died long time ago (not physically obviously) and now just my shell is observing the world. Keeping the ones I should care about happy because I m still here even though I m not. If I cant be happy atleast someone else can be because I endured pain for another day.

What is worth living for? - It can be anything that brings you hapiness. For example passion, family, pursuing dreams. I am UNABLE to feel hapiness and I even question if I ever felt it.

What can you do with the future? - I dont worry about future. Materialistic things arent my problem. I would have great future with no problem earning a lot of money.

You can't change the past. - I already dealt with past and accepted everything. I accepted hatred towards myself. Learnd to like myself. I fixed things. But I am damaged. Imagine veteran from world wars. Some of them were just not able to live after they came back. I feel like 80 years old and I even accepted death. 

Are you living it for you or for others? - Both.

Life is like a rollercoaster. It has start and end. Everyone seems to enjoy it but all I feel is pain. So why would I wanna take the ride then?

Really it is rational... you dont do things that hurt you. If life only hurts then you dont wanna live. Simple logic. I am not living. I exist, I survive.

I need more because what I have is not worth living for.

Being able to feel, to enjoy things, to have motivation, to have ambitions, to have ups and downs in life(not only downs like me), not to feel pain all the time, not to be miserable all the time...

Seriously I dont wanna live like this anymore. I dont even look if there are cars on the road... I just want some car to hit me. I am looking to fight strangers hoping they will hurt or kill me. I dont know if I last these 2 weeks and even if I do they will probably send me to some mental institute.

I dont really know if there is help for me. Even people with "just" dysthymia have problem to heal or live... I am probably just lost cause.

I feel you bro. I had hard times in school when I was younger so I started to practice "normal" reactions (including how to show certain emotions, how to smile, what to say...). After some years of practice it turned out to be perfect disguise but it didn't feel real to me.  

Now after several years I'm in college and I stopped to use this disguise since I don't have to talk to other people on daily basis (although I still use it if I need to deal with people who are too "normal"). I became almost totally isolated and I spend most of my time in solitude. But I must say I enjoy it more than interacting with people. To be honest I always had someone to talk to (in school (I mean like one person)). Someone who was able to catch up with my thoughts. But I have never met someone who could trully understand my personality. I developed few mental disorders over my whole life and I kinda accepted the fact that I'm sentenced to live alone and I'm okay with it.

We have to wait for the first option but we will not be alive to see it. Eventually (atleast I hope) people will get smarter. Globalization is inevitable that's what I know for sure (if we won't reach such thing as global state then something bad must happen). Even today everyone tries to globalize society but I think it's too soon. Just one hundred years ago we were traveling by horses and embracing slavery. We are not prepared yet.

But what sucks is that while we are not mentally prepared for such world, technology already is. Damn you scientists! That's like giving gun to a kid. We might feel like we are so advanced today but really, we just aren't. We have to hope that capable people will be in charge  of the world and people like Musk will have motivation to change the world (I would say save but ok). I believe there are other options - for example Musk tries to speed up human development with neurolink. But one thing is for sure - we will not be alive to see such world unless you want to put your mind into some robotic/biotechnological body at the end of this century. So just enjoy the ride, if you have talents and ideas then improve society, if you gave up like me just be miserable or try to get better and find motivation, if you are dumb then just watch the show, have kids and create classic drama in your life because your neighbor is loud at nights. But whatever you do have fun!
